QUOTE: Otherwise `ServerManager::is_explicitly_allowed` builds `tool:<first arg value or *>` and calls `PermissionManager::is_allowed`, which returns true on the first allow pattern that matches.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer places the allow check inside check_approval but never states that the allow list doesn't grant execution, only suppresses approval, nor that it's consulted only there. It even says deny is checked "even for calls that were auto-approved or allow-listed", which is not the stated item.
